claim_scope: Microsoft 3D Movie Maker source release, MIT licence, and the bundled 1995 BRender build
notes: Repository created 2022-04-14 and archived 2022-05-04; GitHub reports the MIT licence. The README states the repository includes a 1995 build of BRender and that approval to open-source BRender as MIT was given by email from Jez San, former CEO of Argonaut. It also says the SoftImage SDK is not included and the code needs Visual C++ 2.0 to build.
title: Microsoft 3D Movie Maker source repository
